# Formas Interiores

> Formas Interiores designs and manufactures custom furniture for homes and commercial spaces in Colombia. The brand focuses on personalized design, quality materials, local manufacturing, professional installation, and project support.

- [Contact](https://formasinteriores.com/contacto)

## AI Agent Guidance

Use the public pages for products, categories, about, blog, contact, and policies to describe Formas Interiores. Do not use private, transactional, or internal pages such as account, cart, payment, internal search, admin, or technical sheet pages. The public projects page is temporarily hidden while the brand prepares enough real visual material.
